responsibility: This header publishes the common attribute subsystem interface used throughout GCC for manipulating declaration and type attributes on tree nodes. It declares APIs for initializing attribute tables, applying and merging attributes, lookup by canonicalized name or namespace, comparing attribute lists and attribute values, building attribute-qualified type/decl variants, diagnosing mismatches, and registering scoped attribute namespaces. It also defines the attr_access helper structure and related access-attribute iteration utilities that describe pointer parameter access modes, bounds, and internal string encodings shared with diagnostics and optimization code.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public tree-attribute API, data helpers such as attr_access, and inline lookup/canonicalization utilities, whereas gcc/attribs.cc provides the language-independent runtime implementation of attribute table management, checking, merging, and application.
